mapper.sql: select c.combination_id, c.generation_id, g.generation_code, g.generation_mode, c.combination_code, c.combination_title, c.combined_odds, c.estimated_return, c.deviation_amount, c.adopted_flag, c.review_by, c.review_time, c.user_id, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, (select count(1) from fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination_item i where i.combination_id = c.combination_id) as match_count from fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination c join fx67ll_dortmund_return_generation g on g.generation_id = c.generation_id
mapper.select: select c.*, g.generation_code, g.generation_mode, g.generation_status, (select count(1) from fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination_item i where i.combination_id = c.combination_id) as match_count from fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination c join fx67ll_dortmund_return_generation g on g.generation_id = c.generation_id where c.combination_id = #{combinationId}

select c.*, g.generation_code, g.generation_mode, g.generation_status, (select count(1) from fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination_item i where i.combination_id = c.combination_id) as match_count from fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination c join fx67ll_dortmund_return_generation g on g.generation_id = c.generation_id where c.combination_id = #{combinationId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination (generation_id, combination_code, combination_title, combination_reason, combined_odds, estimated_return, deviation_amount, adopted_flag, combination_image_object_keys, combination_remark, user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{generationId}, #{combinationCode}, #{combinationTitle}, #{combinationReason}, #{combinedOdds}, #{estimatedReturn}, #{deviationAmount}, #{adoptedFlag}, #{combinationImageObjectKeys}, #{combinationRemark}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination set adopted_flag = #{adoptedFlag}, review_by = #{reviewBy}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where combination_id = #{combinationId}
